layers.process: Iberá National Park: entry through any portal (Cambyretá, San Nicolás, Laguna Iberá or Carambola) is free. The only requirement is to register with the park staff or complete the self-registration at the public-use area. APN's fee table lists an Iberá daily pass (general ARS 25,000, about A$23.19), but APN says charging at Iberá and several other parks starts only once the access-control infrastructure and services are in place. (No RBA rate for ARS; at the Banco Central de la República Argentina rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 1,078.2486 ARS).

laws.rule: Corrientes’ Iberá provincial park authority says hunting of any species is prohibited in provincial parks and reserves.

Corrientes’ Iberá provincial park authority says extractive fishing is prohibited in protected natural areas, while sport fishing with release is regulated. Check the current rules for the specific waters and species.
